speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to examine you. Can you tell me how long you have been a newborn and what your parents noticed is wrong with you?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful background information. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunization, have you noticed any jaundice, difficulty feeding, or unusual lethargy in the infant so far?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (suggesting Patent Ductus Arteriosus), non-blanching skin macules (petechiae/purpura), cloudy lenses, and sensorineural deafness constitutes the classic triad of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. Given the mother's lack of prenatal care and immunization, this is a highly probable diagnosis.
